properties.openingHoursNote: 24/7 with MLAK Eligible users (including Companion Card holders and others with specific access requirements) can obtain a MLAK from National Disability Services WA or borrow a key from the South Beach Café during open hours

properties.name: Terminal 1 International Level 2 - Near Gates 54
properties.description: There are 2 toilet corridors, one has All Gender Ambulant cubicles, parents room and all gender accessible RH. The other corridor has access to more pans M F blocks and showers. be aware of options rather than wait, if desired.
properties.address: 2 Horrie Miller Drive, Perth Airport, WA
properties.addressNote: Located in Terminal 1 International on Level 2. In the departures area near gates 54 (near WHsmith). Accessible to passengers after passport control and security screening.
properties.openingHoursNote: Open for all departing international flights.
properties.accessNote: MLAK key for Changing Places Access only. If you have forgotten key, ask Airline or Retail staff to contact the Terminal Duty Manager- who holds a spare.
properties.adultChangeNote: Access to Changing Places is available to passengers in this departure lounge, however they must go to gate 50 (follow signage to level 1, past sensory room). MLAK key required.
